title: Glicht's Revamped End
description: I was thinking that the end was missing something. So , i made a mod with MCreator that add an new ore and armor.
body:
this mod add a new ore and armor to minecraft. The end have been missing content since the 1.9 update, so i've created a mini end update. 

Here's the features : 

- Enderite Ore
- Endrium Ingot
- Endrium Armor

I know that it's not a lot, but it's my first mod, so please understand .
